name: WISE 0855-0714

field_notes.label: Synthetic W2 (real W2 response curve)
field_notes.ref: published W2 ≈ 13.9 mag (0.48 mJy); CatWISE2020 13.82 (0.51 mJy)

caveat: 14% of the W2 response lies beyond SPHEREx's 5.0 µm limit and is filled by extending the last measured bin (4.97 µm) as a flat tail; the ±0.02 mJy is statistical and conditional on that tail. Setting the unobserved tail to zero or to twice the flat extension gives 0.41–0.49 mJy (sensitivity scenarios, not confidence bounds). No WISE colour correction is applied. The AllWISE catalogue value (13.70 mag, 0.57 mJy) is blended at the 2010 position
